board_generations: There are three generations of wall menu, plus the vitrina tags. G1 (≤2019) is hand-chalked blackboards in light wooden frames, with prices written with an apostrophe (3'50€). It appears only in p135 (EXIF 2019-02-08): Desayunos + Meriendas, Menús ensaladas, and a salads board cut off at the edge. G2 (≈2021 to spring 2023) is pine boards with brown print, white arrow banners and prices on stickers or patches, with P/G columns for juices. There are five panels: Desayunos, Menús, Ensaladas, Tostas y Sándwich, and Zumos y Licuados + Smoothies. G2 appears in p112 (EXIF 2021-12-18), p162 (EXIF 2022-05-14, checked in the original), p013/p011 (2022-07), p120 (undated) and p119 (2023-04-30, bottom edge only). G3 (October 2023 to today) is black printed chalk-style boards with colour icons and yellow prices. Its five panels are Desayunos (hasta las 11:00h), Menús, Tostas y Sándwich, Ensaladas and Bebidas. G3 appears in p158/p149 (both EXIF 2023-10-11, the same visit) and p012 (EXIF 2025-11-15, out of focus behind a glass screen). The catalogue calls p012's boards 'antiguas', but EXIF shows G3 is the newest generation. The vitrina tags are white printed cards with a zigzag band in wooden blocks, using one template from 2023-02 (p056) to 2025-11 (p166). The till receipts (PANPAN / PANBER CAFE, S.L.) run from 2017 to 2025.

conflicts: Salad prices in 2025 (p012, out of focus behind glass): I checked consA-p012-ens.jpg and made crops arb-p012-prL/prR.jpg from the 4000 px original. All six prices are 5,xx € and no digit after '5,' can be read, so the readers' 5,50/5,90/5,95/5,75 are not used. The menu shows the last legible price (p162, 2022-05), which is out of date.

p149 (2023-10) sandwich prices: the arb-p149-sandpr.jpg crop is unreadable because of lamp glare. Salmón 4,95 € (A and B, consistent with the consA crop) is kept as probable. Ventresca, club and York y queso keep their 2022 price, because the 2023 figures (5,50 / 5,50 / 3,25-4,25) are guesses. The name 'de York y queso a la plancha' is confirmed in consA-p149-tostas.jpg, so 'pavo' is ruled out.

The p149 tag 'Chocolate 1€' (arb-p149-tag.jpg): five letters, the last two 'UT'. Reader B's 'FRAUT' is not a product. It is taken as 'PANUT Chocolate', which matches p046 (PANUT Chocolate 1€, 2023-08). The first letters are still blurred, and the tray in front is empty.
Third pizza tag in p166 (2025-11): illegible even at 5× (arb-p166-pz3.jpg). Whether Jamón y queso, Cuatro quesos and Verduras went up to 2,85 € is not confirmed.
Zumo de naranja: the 2024 receipts give 'ZUMO NARANJA 2,20' without a size. On the 2022 board it was P 1,90 € / G 2,85 €.
Ensaimada 0,80 € in p158 (possibly 0,90). The 'ENSAIMADA Plus 0,70€' tag in p119 stands in front of an almond pastry and may not match it.
Quiche York y queso: 1,95 € on the 2023-04 tag vs 1,90 € on the 2024-07 receipt. Mini almond croissant: 1,00 € on tags vs 1,20 € on the receipt.

p135 (2019): the Desayunos hours read 12h (A) or 11h (B). The Merienda pastries and hours are uncertain. The salads board is cut off (CÉ…, OT…, AM/AN…, BA…, CO…); it may be the same salads, but this is not confirmed.
Menú Básico 2023-10: 8,25 € (a first digit of 6 is not ruled out). The 2025 Menús board shows no prices, so current menu and breakfast prices are unconfirmed.
Palmera de chocolate (p014/p194): the name and price are taken from an out-of-focus tag.
Items known only from catalogue snippets (COCA DE CALABAZA, BOMBON, CORTADO, ECLAIR VAINILLA): not re-read line by line.
Discarded: SaVia and kombucha (bottles seen on the counter, never priced as products); p100 and p030 (totals only).
